summary: Payment tracking system fully tested. All 10 backend tests passed. Frontend client-side 'Moje rezervacije' shows 3 payment states correctly. Admin dashboard grid blocks colored correctly (amber for sent_for_verification, green for confirmed). Admin detail dialog shows 'Potvrdi uplatu' button for sent_for_verification status. Full flow tested: create reservation → report payment → admin confirm payment.

Backend: PATCH /api/reservations/{id}/report-payment returns 400 if already confirmed
Backend: PATCH /api/admin/reservations/{id}/confirm-payment changes status to confirmed (requires admin token)
Backend: PATCH /api/admin/reservations/{id}/confirm-payment returns 403/401 without auth
Backend: PATCH /api/admin/reservations/{id}/confirm-payment returns 404 for invalid ID
